verdict.rationale: Bulk item operations are not a natural axis for a discrete GPU. However, the companion NVIDIA app is documented as letting users update hundreds of games to the latest DLSS features and models in one place, which is a narrow, single-purpose bulk operation. missing for 10: general-purpose bulk operations beyond DLSS game updates, any scriptable/agent-driven or API-based batch control, hands-on or independent corroboration of the bulk update workflow.
